relations.note: Bythos belongs to the primordial pair ancestral to Logos.
Sige belongs to the primordial pair ancestral to Logos.
Nous emits Logos together with Zoe, with Aletheia as co-parent.
Aletheia is Logos' co-parent with Nous in the principal Ogdoad.
Zoe is Logos' syzygy and co-progenitor of subsequent aeons.
Logos and Zoe emit Anthropos with Ecclesia in the standard genealogy.
A competing scheme makes Anthropos the immediate source of Logos.
Logos and Zoe emit Ecclesia together with Anthropos.
Logos and Zoe jointly emit Bythios as an aeon of the Decad.
Logos and Zoe jointly emit Mixis as an aeon of the Decad.
Logos and Zoe jointly emit Ageratos as an aeon of the Decad.
Logos and Zoe jointly emit Henosis as an aeon of the Decad.
Logos and Zoe jointly emit Autophyes as an aeon of the Decad.
Logos and Zoe jointly emit Hedone as an aeon of the Decad.
Logos and Zoe jointly emit Acinetos as an aeon of the Decad.
Logos and Zoe jointly emit Syncrasis as an aeon of the Decad.
Logos and Zoe jointly emit this Monogenes as an aeon of the Decad.
Logos and Zoe jointly emit Macaria as an aeon of the Decad.

relations.myth: Logos attempts to comprehend the Father
relations.note: Logos reaches toward the incomprehensible Father without proper mediation, precipitating division.

relations.myth: The Son reveals himself to converted Logos
relations.note: The Son gives Logos knowledge, stability, and the pattern for restoration.

relations.myth: Logos separates from and returns toward the Totality
relations.note: Logos acts individually within the Totality; his separated members require reintegration.

relations.myth: Logos organizes the lower cosmic economy
relations.note: The Demiurge operates ignorantly but providentially within the economy produced by Logos.

relations.myth: The Savior completes Logos' restorative economy
relations.note: The Savior completes what Logos cannot and gathers the spiritual members toward restoration.

relations.myth: Aeons are instructed after Sophia's disturbance
relations.note: Christ stabilizes and instructs Logos with the other aeons.

relations.myth: Aeons are instructed after Sophia's disturbance
relations.note: Holy Spirit stabilizes and instructs Logos with the other aeons.
Logos joins all aeons in contributing excellence to produce the common fruit Jesus.
One faction derives the Savior specifically from the ten descendants of Logos and Zoe.

relations.myth: Gabriel occupies Logos' place at Jesus' birth
relations.note: Gabriel corresponds to Logos' position in one account of Jesus' birth.
In the standard genealogy, Sophia is a remote descendant of Logos within the Dodecad.
One marked Tripartite Tractate passage describes Logos as an offspring of Wisdom.

relations.myth: Error persecutes the revealer and knowledge dissolves Error
relations.note: Error persecutes the revelatory Logos and is dissolved when he reveals the Father.

relations.myth: Protennoia manifests as Logos in her third descent
relations.note: Logos is Protennoia's third revelatory manifestation, not an independent offspring.

relations.myth: A luminous Logos emerges from divine Mind
relations.note: In the Hermetic account, divine Mind generates a luminous Logos.

relations.myth: Logos joins creative Mind to order the cosmos
relations.note: The Hermetic Logos joins the creative Mind in separating and ordering the elements.
